about.title: About P.H CLONE
about.intro: P.H CLONE is a place to discover new apps and tools. Products are published by the administration, organized by topic and ranked by the votes of the community.

publish.title: Products are published
publish.text: The administration publishes products, groups them by topic and reviews some of them with a rating. Upcoming ones are listed as coming soon.

vote.title: You vote
vote.text: Log in and upvote the products you like. You get one vote per product, and you can take it back at any time.

reorder.title: The list reorders
reorder.text: Votes decide the order: the most voted products come first, and the list updates as soon as you vote.

portfolio.title: A portfolio project
portfolio.text: P.H CLONE is a full-stack portfolio project: a Next.js front end talking to an Express API, with the business rules kept apart from the frameworks.

cta.title: Ready to pick your favorites?
cta.text: Create an account to vote for the products you like, or just browse what the community is upvoting.
